summary: Enhance your understanding of human rights in criminal investigations with our comprehensive training course. Equip yourself with essential skills for justice.
lede: Human rights in criminal investigations and prosecutions means applying safeguards while building and presenting cases. Designed for investigators, prosecutors, forensic personnel and other justice professionals, the course addresses how to document decisions and handle evidence while respecting the rights of suspects, victims and witnesses. Participants practise identifying rights risks, conducting non-coercive interviews and making fair charging and disclosure decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who make or influence decisions in criminal investigations and prosecutions.
audience: Internal affairs and professional standards units
Judiciary support staff and court users committees
Immigration, border, and customs enforcement officers
Anti-corruption, economic crimes, and cybercrime investigators
Victim support, child protection, and SGBV response
Human rights officers, NGO legal advocates
outcomes: Search Seizure And Digital Evidence Handling

Evidence Handling and Chain of Custody
Digital Evidence and Cyber Investigations With Rights Compliance
Victim and Witness Rights in Case Building
Prosecutorial Decision-Making and Fair Trial Standards

Courtroom Readiness and Defending Rights-Based Decisions
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of criminal law and justice systems. Prior experience in investigations or legal practice is recommended.
